mapper.insert: INSERT INTO design_version (task_id, version_no, file_name, file_path, file_size, note, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{versionNo}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{note}, #{uploadedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS `id`, v.task_id AS `taskId`, v.version_no AS `versionNo`, v.file_name AS `fileName`, v.file_path AS `filePath`, v.file_size AS `fileSize`, v.note AS `note`, v.uploaded_at AS `uploadedAt`, u.real_name AS `uploadedByName` FROM design_version v LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.uploaded_by WHERE v.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY v.version_no
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM design_version WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
